topic: Sequence-of-returns risk -- a market crash in your first retirement years does far more damage than the same crash later
title: Why a Crash Right After You Retire Is So Dangerous
description:
The timing of a market crash can have a devastating impact on your retirement savings. A downturn in your first few years of withdrawal does far more damage than the same crash a decade later. This is sequence-of-returns risk.

#retirement #investing #401k #sequenceofreturns #personalfinance
